_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "firebase_uid" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "birth_date" INTEGER NULL, "gender" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'preferNotToSay', "locale" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en', "emergency_contact" TEXT NULL, "emergency_phone" TEXT NULL, "gdpr_consent_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "gdpr_consent_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gdpr_consent_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "consent_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "granted" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("granted" IN (0, 1)), "policy_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_queue" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "target_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "retry_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "calibration_metrics" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "week_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "meals_logged" INTEGER NOT NULL, "glucose_readings" INTEGER NOT NULL, "manual_readings" INTEGER NOT NULL, "covered_meals" INTEGER NOT NULL, "uncovered_reasons" TEXT NOT NULL, "app_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced', "last_modified_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "medications" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "dosage" TEXT NOT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "times" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced', "last_modified_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "medication_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "medication_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES medications (id), "scheduled_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "taken_time" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "notes" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced', "last_modified_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "symptoms" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "severity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "tags" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced', "last_modified_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "glucose_readings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "value_mg_dl" REAL NOT NULL, "measured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NULL, "meal_context" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced', "last_modified_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "eaten_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "tags" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced', "last_modified_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "health_samples" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_at" INTEGER NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NULL, "metadata" TEXT NULL, "last_modified_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "muscle_group" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment" TEXT NOT NULL, "instructions" TEXT NULL, "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_templates" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "estimated_duration" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "template_exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "template_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_templates (id), "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "default_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL, "default_reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "default_weight" REAL NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "template_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES workout_templates (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_time" INTEGER NULL, "total_volume" REAL NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "rating" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced', "last_modified_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id), "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "set_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight" REAL NOT NULL, "is_warmup" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_warmup" IN (0, 1)), "is_p_r" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_p_r" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "personal_records" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "weight" REAL NOT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "estimated1_r_m" REAL NOT NULL, "achieved_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_stats" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "total_workouts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_volume" REAL NOT NULL, "total_duration" INTEGER NOT NULL, "streak_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "medication_compliance" REAL NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "achievements" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "requirement" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unlocked_at" INTEGER NULL, "icon_name" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "generated_insights" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "insight_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_read" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_read" IN (0, 1)), "is_dismissed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_dismissed" IN (0, 1)), "valid_until" INTEGER NOT NULL, "generated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_glucose_readings_external_id ON glucose_readings (external_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_health_samples_external_id ON health_samples (external_id)
